itens.trecho: Seria bom, se não fosse um filme da franquia “Bourne”. Depois de três bons filmes, a franquia “Bourne” parece estar lançada sobre sólidos alicerces, e o sucesso dos filmes seguintes parece garantido.

The Bourne Legacy perfects the action style of the franchise with a little more brutality making this spin-off hit hard and greatly entertain. The Bourne Legacy spins off from the Bourne franchise and follows a new agent who has been betrayed by the government and must go in the run to survive.

66/100 Because of Bourne's exposure of covert agencies within our government in "Ultimatum", these same agencies decide it's best to shut them all down. Aaron Cross, an agent from the Outcome operation isn't too happy about that.
